I'd love a coffee before my shift starts. What kind do you recommend today?
I think we're both running a bit behind schedule, so maybe we can grab that coffee and head to the cafe together?
Sounds good! I'll meet you at the cafe and we can grab our coffees together. I'm looking forward to a busy day at work.

Yeah, me too. Let's get the cafe ready for the morning rush. I'll start setting up the pastry display.
I'm excited to get started on the morning rush. I hope it's a busy day! How about you, Maeve?
I'm excited to get started on the morning rush. Bernard is already setting up the coffee machines. We should get going too.
I'm all set to start prepping the coffee machines. Let's make sure we're both ready for the morning rush.
Yeah, me too. I think we're both ready for the morning rush. Let's get the cafe open!
I'm so glad we're both on the same page, Maeve. Let's get those orders ready and make this morning rush a breeze. What's the plan for today's specials?
Hey, Dolores, I think we're all set for the morning rush. Let's make sure to keep the cafe tidy and organized throughout the day.
